caption: The drawing depicts a scene featuring a two-story house on the left side, painted in light brown tones with a sloped roof and two prominent chimneys. The house has several windows with dark outlines and a small entrance porch reached by a short set of stairs. To the right of the house is a fenced area filled with green trees of varying shades, mostly a wash of light and medium green, with thin brown trunks. Behind the trees and partially obscured is a glass greenhouse with a peaked roof, visible through the fence. The yard is mostly grass-colored with some bushes and shrubs near the right side, along the fence. In the background on the right, there is a small shed or doghouse structure in muted reddish-brown and pink tones. The entire scene is enclosed by a black or dark brown metal fence, and the foreground consists of a sidewalk with paving sections depicted in light gray and tan, and a low brick wall separating the sidewalk from the grassy area. The sky is left mostly uncolored except for a faint wash, giving an impression of a clear or lightly clouded day.
title: Cargle Estate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
